::: {.why}
The model is wrong and the regression is still the workhorse of every risk decomposition you will run, so the useful skill is knowing what the coefficient means when the model behind it fails.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Say what beta is estimating, what the intercept is testing, and what the residual variance becomes in a risk model.
- Report the cross-sectional relationship between beta and average return in your own sample, and say whether it matches the theory.
